composition.serve_who: This sheet is an electrical trunking/cable routing General Arrangement (schematic overlaid on hull outline) showing cable tray/trunking runs fore-to-aft through the vessel, plus deck-level and section details at the AFT DC Elec Panel, ONYX panel, A/C Contactor Panel, PMD & MID AC breakers, Galley Elec Connection Panel, and Galley Lights Panel. The trunking itself is shared vessel infrastructure (routing backbone) rather than belonging to any single piece of equipment; the panels named in the callouts are the equipment served by these runs.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: DC Distribution Panels (AFT DC Elec Panel)

functions.label: AFT DC Electrical Panel cable feed
functions.what_it_does: Receives trunked cable runs routed aft through the hull trunking system, distributing DC power/control wiring to the aft DC electrical panel (1220x950mm) shown in the mid-ship section view.

flow_scenarios.path: Trunking backbone (100W x 140H custom alu trunking) → routed along hull side/deckhead → terminates at AFT DC ELEC PANEL enclosure

functions.dry_data: Panel size 1220x950mm; feed via 3mm custom alu trunking per BOM item 2/3
functions.sheet_region: Mid-sheet section view, 'AFT DC ELEC PANEL' labelled box

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Labelled directly as 'AFT DC ELEC PANEL' in a titled box on the sheet; DC distribution panels node is the closest register match for a named DC panel.

functions.label: ONYX panel cable feed
functions.what_it_does: Cable trunking run terminates at the ONYX panel (labelled 'ONYX PANEL 3W8.03') adjacent to the AFT DC panel, providing its monitoring system wiring routing.

flow_scenarios.path: Trunking backbone → branch to ONYX PANEL enclosure (3W8.03)

functions.sheet_region: Mid-sheet section view, adjacent to AFT DC ELEC PANEL box

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Explicitly labelled 'ONYX PANEL' box on sheet, matches ONYX Monitoring & Control node.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: AC Contactor Panel / PMD & MID AC Breakers

functions.label: A/C contactor and breaker panel cable feed
functions.what_it_does: Trunking routes cabling to the 'A/C CONTACTOR PANEL - TOP' and adjacent 'PMD & MID AC BREAKERS' enclosures, serving AC distribution/contactor switching for the vessel's AC system.

flow_scenarios.path: Trunking backbone → branch up to A/C CONTACTOR PANEL - TOP and PMD & MID AC BREAKERS boxes

functions.dry_data: Labelled boxes only; no ratings given on this sheet
functions.sheet_region: Mid-sheet section view, right-hand pair of labelled boxes

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Labelled as AC contactor/breaker panels; best-fit is the main AC distribution panel node since no dedicated 'contactor panel' node exists.

functions.label: Galley connection panel feed
functions.what_it_does: Trunking run along the transom/aft section feeds the 'GALLEY ELEC CONNECTION PANEL' shown in the lower-left aft transverse section.

flow_scenarios.path: Trunking backbone (aft transverse run) → GALLEY ELEC CONNECTION PANEL enclosure

functions.dry_data: No electrical rating legible on this sheet
functions.sheet_region: Lower-left aft transverse hull section, yellow box labelled 'GALLEY ELEC CONNECTION PANEL'

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Labelled panel box; treated as a distribution panel, closest node is DC/electric panel node since specific galley panel node does not exist.

functions.label: Galley lighting panel feed
functions.what_it_does: Trunking branch feeds the 'GALLEY LIGHTS PANEL' box in the same aft transverse section, supplying the galley lighting circuit.

flow_scenarios.path: Trunking backbone → branch to GALLEY LIGHTS PANEL enclosure

functions.dry_data: No rating legible on this sheet
functions.sheet_region: Lower-left aft transverse hull section, yellow box labelled 'GALLEY LIGHTS PANEL'

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Directly labelled 'GALLEY LIGHTS PANEL', matches lights-galley circuit node.

Item4 150Wx140H Custom 3mm thk Alu Trunking (KM13), qty 2.9m, unit 4.0kg, total 11.6kg
Item5 100Wx50H Custom Cable Tray 100x50, qty 3.0m, unit 1.8kg, total 5.5kg
Item6 75Wx75H Custom Electric PVC Trunking 75x75, qty 2.5m, unit 0.7kg, total 1.8kg

Multiple hull-outline plan/section views show pink/magenta highlighted trunking routes running fore-to-aft along topsides, through bulkheads, and down into aft/transom sections, plus a 3D isometric routing detail bottom-right showing bent trunking sections with dimensioned offsets
Cross-section details at multiple frame stations show trunking passing through structural members with dimensioned clearances (bend/offset details in circular blow-up details)
